acceptance: Coordinate sequential bounded process and launcher child tasks to complete the preserved usage-accounting dependency without changing task, budget, worktree, Git, handoff, completion, or host-authority boundaries.

Capture bounded child stdout through the mechanical process boundary while preserving log/inherited-output behavior, and parse only secret-safe finite Pi usage/cost observations with explicit duplicate, malformed, truncated, and unavailable semantics.

Persist accounting only in private runtime evidence; public handles, registries, diagnostics, traces, and structured projections must not expose accounting paths, prompts, content, provider payloads, or raw usage records.

Validate process and launcher behavior, clean-checkout builds, focused accounting/privacy/lifecycle tests, task-record/content/backlog/JSON/whitespace checks, and fresh read-only expert review before completion.
